title: Move between branches

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Now that we have a `map` branch, let's move to it.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: `git switch map` moves your HEAD to the map branch.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: And `git switch -c <name>` makes a new branch and moves to it in one go.

items.text: Create and move to a schedule branch

hints: You need to visit an existing branch, then create a new one.
`git switch <name>` moves to a branch. `git switch -c <name>` creates and moves.
Type `git switch map`, then `git switch -c schedule`.
recap: `git switch <branch>` moves you to a branch. `git switch -c <branch>` creates and moves in one go.

cheatSheet.summary: Create and move to a new branch
